blocks.tamil_translation: , and if he does not find water, let him make Tayammum. Then, when he calls the Iqamah and prays, the two angels on his two sides (who write the good and the bad) pray with him. When he calls the Adhan, then calls the Iqamah and prays, a great multitude of the army of Allah (the angels) pray behind him. They will be so many that the two ends of their row cannot be seen,” Hazrat Salman Farsi (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: يَعْجَبُ رَبُّكَ مِنْ رَاعِي غَنَمٍ فِي رَاْسِ شَظِيَّةٍ بِجَبَلٍ يُؤَذِّنُ للِصَّلَاةِ وَيُصَلِّي فَيَقُولُ اللهُ : أُنْظُرُوا إِلَي عَبْدِي هذَا يُؤَذِّنُ وَيُقِيمُ للِصَّلَاةِ يَخَافُ مِنِّي قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي وَأَدْخَلْتُهُ الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب الاذان في السفر، رقم:١٢٠٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say: “When a man grazing goats on a mountain peak calls the Adhan and prays, your Lord, delighted beyond measure, says to the angels, ‘Look at My servant who calls the Adhan and prays; he does all this out of fear of Me. I have forgiven My servant, and I have decided to admit him into Jannah.’”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: ثِنْتَانِ لَاتُرَدَّانِ أَوْ قَلَّمَا تُرَدَّانِ: الدُّعَاءُ عِنْدَ النِّدَاءِ، وَعِنْدَ الْبَأْسِ حِينَ يُلْحِمُ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد، باب الدعاء عند اللقاء، رقم:٢٥٤٠
